messages.content: You are a computational biologist. Given a CRISPR screen description, produce a ranked list of 100 gene symbols (HGNC nomenclature for Homo sapiens) that you believe are MOST LIKELY to be hits in this screen, ordered strongest first. Use only your knowledge of biology — no chain-of-thought in the output. Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 symbols, no prose, no numbering.

## Goal

You are tasked with ranking genes from a genetic perturbation screen. Based on the experimental context and hit criteria provided below, provide a list of exactly 100 genes that are hits in this screen, ranked from strongest to weakest according to the criteria defined below.

## Experimental Context

This screen was performed in HEK293T cells, a Embryonic Kidney Cell Line. Researchers used a CRISPRn library (Knockout) to systematically perturb gene function. The experiment followed a Timecourse design and was conducted over 7 Days.

## Screen Objective

The primary objective of this screen was to identify a set of hit genes, each of which either increases or decreases SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency.

## Hit Definition

A gene is classified as a "hit" if its Knockout significantly either increases or decreases SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency. The statistical criterion for significance is: Score.1 (Log2FC) < 0.0 AND Score.2 (p-Value) < 0.01 OR Score.1 (Log2FC) > 0.0 AND Score.3 (p-Value) < 0.01.

## Ranking Criteria

Genes with low Log2FC, low p-Value (decrease SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency) OR high Log2FC, low p-Value (increase SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency) are ranked most highly.

## Additional Context
Screen notes: A reporter-based genome-wide CRISPR/Cas9 knockout screen was carried out to identify  human host modulators of SARS-CoV-2  programmed -1 ribosomal frameshifting (-1 PRF), a process used by coronaviruses to regulate the translation of their polycistronic viral RNAs.   A dual fluorescent protein-based reporter was used in this knockout screen to quantify SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency. Gene hits with negative log fold changes (LFCs) are -1 PRF suppressors and those with positive LFCs are enhancers. (7-day timecourse)

## Required Output Format

Provide your response as an ordered list of exactly 100 HGNC gene symbols, using the ranking criteria above.
That is, top genes should have low Log2FC, low p-Value (decrease SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency) OR high Log2FC, low p-Value (increase SARS-CoV-2 -1 PRF efficiency).

Format: 
GENE1, GENE2, GENE3, ..., GENE100

=== Final instruction ===
Return ONLY a comma-separated list of 100 gene symbols (no prose, no numbers, no markdown). All gene symbols must use the HGNC convention for Homo sapiens (e.g. 'TP53' for HGNC, 'Trp53' for MGI). Do not return symbols from another organism.
